scope: Independent causal challenge of existing closed bags/source artifacts; no runtime edits, ROS startup or robot commands.

verified_core_findings.classification: Source-proven logic defect under the observed moving-repair path
verified_core_findings.evidence: planner_manager.cpp:548-552 waits until trajectory_start_time if early; remani_replan_fsm.cpp:3392-3405 requires >=20ms lead after manager return. All three observed successful optimizer results were subsequently rejected late.
verified_core_findings.causal_limit: Reported ~700ms whole repair latency includes explicit sleep; not proof the optimizer exceeded its .60s budget.

verified_core_findings.classification: Observed timing inconsistency plus source-proven fallback semantics
verified_core_findings.evidence: FSM fallback at remani_replan_fsm.cpp:1123-1149 replaces scaled/paused controller phase with wall elapsed and scale1 when progress unavailable/mismatched/stale; logged phase7.624840736 equals wall time, near controller phase6.278167469.
verified_core_findings.causal_limit: Fallback predicate/cached progress stamp were not logged. Difference can change scanned reference segment and distance/TTC, but does not prove the real robot was collision-free, that this was a false positive, or that correcting phase alone prevents the stop.

verified_core_findings.classification: Observed policy inconsistency backed by branch inspection
verified_core_findings.evidence: Raw dynamic near-stop calls beginTransientObstacleRecovery at1931 and retains goal across failed recovery; later map-collision ordinary emergency path at~2110 bypasses that helper, EMERGENCY_STOP 979-993 enters ordinary GEN_NEW_TRAJ, and 691-703 clears accepted target after5 failures. Logs show failures1/5 at49.441281 through5/5 at49.588342, give-up49.588383.
verified_core_findings.causal_limit: This is explicit goal deletion by ordinary failure policy, not evidence an auto-recovery switch was disabled. It does not establish that no valid path existed.

verified_core_findings.classification: Confirmed observed chain; upstream root still undetermined
verified_core_findings.evidence: Parent independently found /robot_self_filter source14.8692877 rejected stale/unavailable joint feedback. velodyne_transformer.py:217-220,316-317,342-344 impose150ms joint freshness and suppress output. Independent mapping recorder and tracker output both have~1.2s gap (stamps14.5701177 to15.7701535), then GridMap timeout15.383077 and ABORT15.381757.
verified_core_findings.causal_limit: Does not identify CAN, SDK, scheduler or raw LiDAR failure. Isolated GridMap heartbeat and separate mapping publisher rule out a purely FSM callback-queue explanation for the published-topic gap. Piper300ms allowance does not alter self-filter150ms gate.

verified_core_findings.classification: Measured functional chain failure; classifier cause not identified
verified_core_findings.evidence: Perception audit counted1795 second-goal dynamic output frames, all0points and all motion-qualified track counts0, despite nonzero residual/clusters and confirmed associations.
verified_core_findings.causal_limit: Association velocity alone is not verified physical motion; cannot yet name a particular threshold/association bug or claim raw LiDAR was empty.

nominal_window_check.source_behavior: active_arm_mppi.py nominal valid/external_gap>=.12 returns without broader base maneuver generation.
nominal_window_check.limit: This proves which branch executed, not that MPPI was disconnected or that no feasible bypass existed.

reference_cancel_check.full_bag_exception: One goal1 cancellation status received10.537178 after recovery ADD10.517433; its capture source10.151573 precedes the new reference epoch10.471313, consistent with delayed old-cycle status.
reference_cancel_check.limit: Use source and receipt times separately; status String has no independent publication header, and input capture is not necessarily publication time.
